applicability.pin_mating_vs_system_surfaces: IRM20 is intended to solder to a mating PCB. Its2.5..4.5mm pins cannot span a5mm body-to-PCB standoff. This distinguishes the intended electrical mating region from external system surfaces; it is NOT permission to ignore enclosure, wiring, carrier/support or bottom insulation requirements. Exact approved construction and scope of these surfaces remain unestablished.
applicability.no_waiver_inferred_from: Potted case, ClassII/noFG, approval marks, short pins, Mylar presence, prior nominal CAD or lack of immediate geometric collision
applicability.independent_obstruction: 10mm on both lateral sides of maximum27.7mm body requires47.7mm width; no43mm bore chord can supply that. This fails even without resolving top/bottom wording, pin/PCB mating, Mylar thickness, mount exemptions or thermal space.

rectangular_reservations.name: body-face-only comparison
rectangular_reservations.assumption: 10mm on both X/Y sides and above,5mm below BODY face; excludes pins as clearance datum, carrier, film and tolerances. Upper10mm is an explicitly conservative interpretation of around, not a separately stated top clause.

rectangular_reservations.name: max-pin-referenced module reservation
rectangular_reservations.assumption: Same side/top reservation,5mm beyond lowest maximum live pin; board/copper stay above that pin in R1. This conservative bottom datum is not asserted to be defined in the manual.

rectangular_reservations.name: same reservation plus illustrative R1 film thickness
rectangular_reservations.assumption: Adds R1 unqualified .125mm film outside full5mm separation; guide specifies neither film thickness nor permission to subtract it from5mm.

rectangular_reservations.name: carrier+pin assembly planning reservation
rectangular_reservations.assumption: Conservative whole carrier61x32 planning box with same allowances. Treating the carrier as part of unit assembly is an engineering reservation, not a manufacturer-specified construction or approved minimum. Retention, trunk, endcaps, leads and cooling may require more.

calculations.box_limit: Diagonal is the bore needed to contain the stated rectangular reservation in isolation. It is not an exact minimum for every conformal insulation construction, permission to enlarge the core, or a whole-barrel pack/thermal/endcap acceptance. All examples already exceedØ43. No geometry revised.
calculations.film: Mylar required; no grade/thickness or distance-credit authorization supplied in the reviewed text. .125mm example is explicitly R1 allocation only.

wire_assembly_prerequisites_in_order: FIRST pass installation source gate with explicit model-specific permitted construction and all applicable external separations/materials. Current architecture is blocked: do not make jig/motion CAD against unaccepted gaps.

Release exact pin/aperture/PTH or solder termination and primary/secondary harness drawings, tolerances, materials, endcap/port/clamp interfaces and access. R1 pin-to-land process and all retention/material/thread/locking qualifications remain open.

Specify a reproducible unpowered sequence: when wires feed throughØ4, when split sleeve fits/seats/retains, when wires terminate and clamps close, and how forming loads are kept out of solder/module pins. Both yellow leads need durable polarity identification.

Prove finite wire/tool/jig access and extraction for every assembly state with protected trunk and endcaps intact, Rmin9 and ODmax1.6 respected including fixture/springback/sleeve tolerance. Final nonintersecting solids alone are not a process. The completed preformed loop has an existing axial-insertion collision.

Only after source gate and process definition: demonstrate repeatable unpowered assembly with measured bend/edge coverage/clearances, solder inspection, polarity/continuity/isolation and approved pull/retention criteria. No such demonstration, fixture design, hardware work or new numerical acceptance limits performed here.
